NaAudio__Pattern__Meta.Name: Seven Against Four
NaAudio__Pattern__Meta.Author: Adam Noble - Noble Architecture
NaAudio__Pattern__Meta.Description: Seven divisions across a four-beat bar. Here to prove the point: this pattern cannot be expressed on a power-of-two grid without a fight, and on the circular sequencer it is simply a seven. Set the sequencer's Divisions to 7 and it lands on the circle unaltered.
NaAudio__Pattern__Meta.WhyThisExists: The free division count is the reason the sequencer is a circle rather than a row. A library with only sixteen-step patterns in it would quietly hide that.
